/* A FALLBACK MUST NOT OUTRANK THE THING IT FALLS BACK FROM.
   `subgrid` makes every row share the PARENT's columns, which is the only
   reason a locant sits over its own carbon and a substituent under it. This
   explicit track count was written as a fallback for browsers without
   subgrid — but declared unconditionally and later in the cascade it
   replaced subgrid everywhere, including the Chrome that renders these
   pages. Each row then sized its OWN `auto` tracks, so the sparse rows
   collapsed: `5 4 3 2 1` bunched together left of centre instead of one
   number per carbon, and `| |` / `H Br` clustered under the middle of the
   chain instead of under C2 and C3.
   The parent keeps its explicit tracks — subgrid needs them to inherit. */
.cst { grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--n), auto); }
/* The row override is GONE, not merely guarded: every renderer this book
   targets supports subgrid, and leaving the fallback in any form invites
   the same silent override back. Rows inherit the parent's tracks. */
.cst>.cst-r>span { display:block; text-align:center; padding:0 1px; }
